name: Big Caring Group Bhd
recent: Big Caring Group 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日在 Bursa Malaysia 主板上市，IPO 涉及最多 18.8 亿股，零售价每股 RM1.08。上市后股价在首日一度跌破发售价，随后回稳。公司同时披露与 Brego Life Sciences 的经常性关联交易金额已超过 1% 门槛。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 19 日在 Bursa Malaysia 主板上市，IPO 涉及最多 1,882,368,000 股，零售价每股 RM1.08。
公司披露与 Brego Life Sciences Sdn. Bhd. 的经常性关联交易在 2026 年 10 月 1 日至 11 月 19 日期间的累计金额超过 1% 门槛。
risks: 公司上市后即披露与 Brego Life Sciences 的关联交易金额超过 1% 门槛，需关注后续关联交易的审批与披露要求。
多名董事及大股东在上市前后申报持股变动，包括 Creador V L.P.、Iris Pallida Sdn. Bhd. 等，需留意股权结构的后续变化。

recent_en: Big Caring Group listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 19 November 2026, with an IPO of up to 1.88 billion shares at a retail price of RM1.08 per share. The share price fell below the IPO price on debut before recovering. The company also disclosed that recurrent related-party transactions with Brego Life Sciences exceeded the 1% threshold.
notable_en: The company listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 19 November 2026, with an IPO of up to 1,882,368,000 shares at a retail price of RM1.08 per share.
The company disclosed that cumulative recurrent related-party transactions with Brego Life Sciences Sdn. Bhd. from 1 October 2026 to 19 November 2026 exceeded the 1% threshold.
Several directors each acquired 461,300 ordinary shares at RM1.08 per share in the open market on 18 November 2026.
risks_en: The company disclosed shortly after listing that related-party transactions with Brego Life Sciences exceeded the 1% threshold; the approval and disclosure requirements for subsequent related-party transactions should be noted.

Several directors and substantial shareholders, including Creador V L.P. and Iris Pallida Sdn. Bhd., reported changes in their shareholdings around the listing; subsequent changes in shareholding structure should be monitored.
